resources.string: This APK contains the game. It is for your own devices only: do not share it.
APK without the game: it only includes the Vulkan probe, to test your phone and GPU driver.
No ISO selected. You need your own Xbox 360 ISO, %1$s edition.
This APK was built for the %1$s edition of the game.
The top speed of the game. 90, 120 and Unlimited are experimental and need a screen that fast. Unlimited lets the game run as fast as the phone can (up to 240 fps).
The size the game is drawn at, before it goes to the screen. 1280×720 is the Xbox 360 one.
Soft edges blurs the shadow outline like the Xbox 360 (more GPU). Like the Xbox 360 also brings back the shadows of trees, bushes and fences (more CPU).
How far away objects still cast shadows. Most of the shadow cost is there.
How many faces of the reflection map of the car are redrawn each frame.
The water reflects it too: without it the sea turns black.
Natural removes the blue fringes the original leaves on trees and roofs. No cost.
The yellow tint, desaturation and vignette of the game. No cost.
The radial blur when accelerating and with NOS. Costs 1.5–2 ms per frame.
OpenGL ES is for phones without Vulkan or with a broken Vulkan driver. Experimental: slower than Vulkan, and some effects are missing.
This edition has no OpenGL ES yet: it plays with Vulkan.
An extra look on top of the one of the game.
The low-latency Android output of this app. Off: the SDL output of the native engine.
Emulates the Xbox 360 GPU instead of using the native renderer, for GPUs that cannot run it. Much slower.
How the game image is taken to the screen size. FSR does the most when the game draws below the screen resolution (Screen: native).
This ISO is incomplete: %1$s of game data are missing at the end of the file, as after a download or an extraction that was cut short. The game will not load with it.
This file is not an Xbox 360 ISO: it has no Xbox 360 file system. It may be the PC or PS2 version, an unextracted .zip or .7z, or another game. With it the game shows a black screen and closes.
This ISO is a different edition of the game. This APK was built for the %1$s edition and will not start with another one: choose the %1$s ISO, or build the APK from this ISO.
This APK includes the %1$s editions of the game.
ISO of the %1$s edition. This APK includes %2$s.
This ISO is an edition of the game that this APK does not include (it includes %1$s): the game will not start with it.
Android did not grant permanent access to that ISO. Pick it from the phone\'s storage.
This APK does not include the game.
Size of the final image on screen. The game itself is rendered the same way.
Off: the Xbox 360\'s 16:9 image, with black bars. On: fills the screen, but distorts the image.
Draws the game at your screen\'s proportion: the camera sees more at the sides, with no bars and no stretching. More pixels to draw. For now the HUD and menus are stretched.
Corner counter: frames per second and milliseconds per frame.
Smooths jagged edges. MSAA is the game\'s own: the finest and the most expensive. FXAA is a filter over the final image: much cheaper, but a little softer.
4x is what the game uses (46 fps vs 60 in the menu). 2x smooths less and costs less.
High smooths more edges, faint ones too, and softens the image a little more.
The original game\'s color filter and blur. Off: less GPU work, but it no longer looks like the original.
Sharper textures seen at an angle, like the road in the distance.
2x renders at 2560×1440: sharper, but much heavier. 1x is recommended.
Puts the game\'s heaviest threads on the fastest cores.
Turnip is Mesa\'s open-source driver for Adreno. Import a Turnip driver .zip (with meta.json) and select it here.
Turnip, Mesa\'s open-source driver, is only for Adreno GPUs: with this GPU (%1$s) the game uses the system driver. You can import another Vulkan driver (.zip with meta.json) to try it.
could not move the driver to %1$s
Locks the GPU clock instead of letting the system adjust it. Only with Turnip on an Adreno GPU. It does not always help: check with the FPS counter.
To test what each thing costs on your phone. The defaults are the recommended ones.
Draws the scene once instead of in three strips: ~30 % fewer draws and about +25-45 % fps in races. It disables the game\'s MSAA, so it turns off with MSAA selected.
Another way to emulate the Xbox 360\'s EDRAM. Ignored if the GPU does not support it.
Sun flares and lights. Makes the game wait for the GPU.
Reads the image back from the GPU every frame. Without it the image looks washed out.
Memory coherence for what the shaders write. May cost performance.
log_level=debug. It tanks the fps: only for diagnosing problems.
Loads the GPU driver and checks what it supports, without the game.
No probe report yet. Tap “Test Vulkan”.
The name the game sees for your profile. Your saves are kept if you change it: they go by the profile ID, not by the name.
Up to 15 letters, numbers and spaces, starting with a letter.
%1$s is yours on %2$s (held for this phone while you play)
%1$s is already taken on %2$s by another phone: pick another gamertag to play there.
Couldn\'t check the gamertag: %1$s doesn\'t answer.
Another phone already has %1$s on %2$s. Do you want to play anyway, without online mode? You can play everything except Xbox Live.
Xbox Live in the game, against an EA server on your Wi-Fi: on a PC (nfsmw-server-lan) or on a phone that hosts. Choose one below or host on this phone.
An IP like 10.0.0.4 or a device name like my-pc
This phone runs the EA server and you play on it too. The others enter this phone\'s IP as their LAN server. Wi-Fi or this phone\'s hotspot.
No Wi-Fi or hotspot: connect to a Wi-Fi or turn on this phone\'s hotspot.
The LAN server could not start: %1$s
%1$s could not be found on this network. Check the name, or use the server\'s IP.
The game as always, without Xbox Live
No server answered. It has to be on the same Wi-Fi (or this phone\'s hotspot) and up to date; otherwise add it by its IP.
Move the touch buttons and change their size and opacity.
The game rumbles the controller: crashes, nitrous, rough ground... A physical controller (USB or Bluetooth) vibrates; with none connected, the phone does.
%1$s (%2$s): Android exposes no motors for this controller, so it can\'t vibrate.
%1$s (%2$s): over USB, Android exposes no motors for it, so this test can\'t make it vibrate. In the game SDL drives it over USB with its own vibration (it asks for USB permission when connected).
No controller connected: the phone vibrates.
In races, free roam and pursuits. The arrows steer all the way, like the lane arrows of drag races; tilting turns the phone into a steering wheel. Drag races always keep their lane arrows.

In menus and in the pause menu there is no pad: swipe to move (in a list of options, sideways changes the value), tap an option to pick it, tap the arrows to change its value and tap the hints at the bottom, like “Ⓐ Accept” or “Ⓑ Back”, to press them. Two fingers, back. The PAD button at the top brings the pad back. In cutscenes, a tap skips them.
Off: like turning pages, swiping left goes to the option on the right. On: swiping right goes to the one on the right.
Further right, less tilt is needed to steer all the way.
Drag a control to move it. SIZE changes the selected one, or all of them if none is selected.
Change all the settings below at once.
30 fps, 1024×576 scaled with FSR, no anti-aliasing, fast shadows close by, and a single car reflection. Uses less battery and runs cooler.
Puts the graphics settings back as they were on a new install on this phone.
Goes back to the graphics settings you had before applying the last preset.

The game saves inside the app, where file managers and the PC can\'t reach. Export leaves a copy in a .zip in the folder you choose (Downloads, Drive…); import puts the ones from a .zip in place of the current ones.
There are no saved games yet.
The saved games on this phone are replaced by the ones in the .zip. A copy of the current ones is kept first in %1$s.
That file is not a saved games copy from this app.
With this permission the app looks for the ISO by itself in the internal storage and on the SD card, without the Android file picker, which on some phones doesn\'t show the internal storage.
With this permission saved games are exported to the %1$s folder of the internal storage, without the Android file picker, which on some phones doesn\'t show the internal storage.
No permission: the Android file picker opens instead.
There is no compatible ISO in the internal storage or on the SD card (up to 6 folders deep). These editions work: %1$s.
%1$d .iso from other games or other editions are not shown.
